name: 3D Weld Lab
_comment: ONE road entity, ONE welder (buildRoadNetMesh): an east-west road at grade at its ends (welding into two cross streets at nodes 1 and 8), rising on ramps to a +9 m elevated deck and descending again. node_elev authors the deck height; the unified welder builds the ramps, the elevated deck, and the piers — the SAME welder that builds the flat streets. Proof-in-code that a road can be 3D and its ramps mesh with the ground streets, with no separate corridor/bridge mesher. (Grade-separated crossings — a deck flying over a LIVE road with a clean underpass — are the next increment: the 2-D weld union can't yet represent two roads overlapping at different heights.)
